apps.name: Great Calculator
apps.privacy_summary: Great Calculator stores calculator preferences and history locally, discloses Google advertising/consent services, and contacts a currency-rate provider only for optional live exchange-rate requests.
apps.ads: Google AdMob banner advertising and Google UMP consent handling are disclosed for the free release.

apps.name: Project Milepost
apps.privacy_summary: Project Milepost stores personal milestones locally, accesses Calendar/photos only when chosen, and may show a compact Google AdMob banner when allowed.
apps.ads: Google AdMob compact top banner advertising is disclosed for this release.

apps.name: Project Scribe
apps.privacy_summary: Project Scribe is a local workspace. It does not include ads, tracking, account sign-in, analytics, or a developer cloud backend in the shipping target.
apps.ads: No advertising SDK or active advertising is included in the shipping target.

apps.name: Project Game Room
apps.privacy_summary: Project Game Room stores gameplay and settings locally. The current build has no active advertising, account system, purchases, chat, or sensitive device permission requests.
apps.ads: Advertising-readiness source is present, but ads are disabled by default and Google advertising packages are not linked in the current archive.

apps.name: Project Calibrate
apps.privacy_summary: Project Calibrate stores preferences and calibration locally, uses hardware permissions only for active tools, requests a currency reference table when needed, and keeps Google AdMob dormant in Build 43.
apps.ads: Build 43 keeps Google AdMob dormant: no Google advertising packages, AdMob identifiers, banner requests, or UMP forms are present.
